items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Tajoe was Taje, the next job was Reno, and I had just left these towns with Nat

ctx.x: Yeah, but no, this was '65. I'll tell you what happened. After Nat died I joined -- I went with Patty Page, and my first job with her was Vegas. The next job

Tajoe was Taje, the next job was Reno, and I had just left these towns with Nat, and I just -- it was so vivid on my mind of being with Nat, I would sign his name sometimes because you know when you work these clubs when you're with a certain act you get a discount, you know. I signed John Collins, Nat Cole, or John Collins, Patti Page. And I found myself signing Nat's name.

And I quit. I put my notice in I just couldn't go through that. You know, it was just kind of anticlimatic, you know. Yeah. So I loved her but no. So I -- while I was rehearsing with her Bobby Trumpet asked me to play with him, as a matter of fact I went out to see him at Whitting Hills, and I told him that I would like to play with him but I was committed to Patti. I would prefer playing with him but I had been rehearsing with her and I couldn't. He said, you know, I admire you for being loyal to Patti, he said,…
